SELECT A.id, A.name, A.locked, B.recipient_id AS recipientId, A.description FROM groups as A LEFT JOIN recipients_groups AS B ON A.id=B.group_id WHERE A.name=#{groupName}
SELECT A.id, A.name, A.locked, B.recipient_id AS recipientId, A.description FROM groups as A LEFT JOIN recipients_groups AS B ON A.id=B.group_id WHERE A.id=CAST(#{groupId} AS uuid)
